text: 证监会公众公司监管司一级巡视员商庆军在2026金融街论坛年会上表示，下一步，我们将进一步加大投资端建设力度，统筹促进一二级市场平衡发展，健全投资和融资相协调的资本市场功能。一方面，完善北交所发行承销制度，稳妥实施新股市值配售，提升二级市场投资者获得感；促进新股合理定价，持续推动询价发行案例落地，适度提升定价弹性。
text_en: Shang Qingjun, a first-level inspector of the CSRC's Public Company Supervision Department, said at the 2026 Financial Street Forum Annual Meeting that next, we will further step up investment-side development, coordinate efforts to promote balanced development of the primary and secondary markets, and improve the function of the capital market in coordinating investment and financing. On the one hand, we will improve the Beijing Stock Exchange's issuance and underwriting system, steadily implement market value-based allocation for IPOs, and enhance secondary-market investors' sense of gain; promote reasonable IPO pricing, continue to push for the implementation of book-building issuance cases, and moderately increase pricing flexibility.
